what: Structured Iterative Population PK Workflow with nlmixr2
title: Structured Iterative Population PK Workflow with nlmixr2
text: Structured, iterative population PK model development nlmixr2. Model development loop: specify model, fit , diagnose , compare parent, decide, modify. poppkflow supports loop records . Declarative model specifications (pk_spec(), pk_add_iiv(), pk_add_cov(), …) instead hand-edited model code. run ledger: ledger/runs.csv (one row per run: lineage, hashes, OFV, dOFV parent, flags, decision) plus ledger/events.csv (append-audit trail) RDS files per run (models/<run>/fit.rds, result.rds, spec.rds, …). Identical runs come cache. Standard diagnostics, flags suggestions every run. Comparison decisions rationale (pk_compare(), pk_decide()). Covariate screening stepwise covariate modelling, robustness checks (multiple starts, seeds), bootstrap, VPC, exposure. report generated ledger (pk_report()).

title: Structured Iterative Population PK Workflow with nlmixr2
code: library(poppkflow)  proj <- pk_project("my_analysis") pk_covariates(tibble::tribble(   ~name , ~type         , ~ref,   "WT"  , "continuous"  , 70  ,   "CRCL", "continuous"  , 100 ,   "SEXF", "categorical" , NA )) dat <- pk_data(system.file("extdata", "example_pk.csv", package = "poppkflow")) pk_check(dat)  # base model r1 <- pk_run(pk_spec(ncmt = 2, lag = TRUE, iiv = c("ka", "cl", "v2")),              note = "Base model", stage = "structural") pk_diagnostics(r1)  # the data suggest a change: modify the parent and fit the candidate r2 <- r1 |>   pk_add_cov("cl", "WT", form = "power", init = 0.75) |>   pk_inits_from(r1) |>   pk_run(note = "WT on CL", stage = "covariate")  pk_compare(r1, r2) pk_decide(r2, "accepted", reason = "dOFV < -6.63 for 1 df; plausible allometric effect")  pk_tree() pk_history()

text: x pk_spec, pk_candidate (result editing verbs, see pk_edit), run reference, run id. run, specification re-used run becomes parent. data Data frame. Default: registered dataset, see pk_data(). must contain required columns (ID, TIME, DV, EVID, AMT); otherwise pk_run() stops run registered. est Estimation settings, see pk_est(). note Free-text description run (changed ). stage Development stage, e.g. "structural", "stochastic", "covariate", "final". id Optional run id. Default: next free runNNN. refit Fit even identical completed run exists? cache identical completed run may returned instead fitting: "same_parent" (default) one parent requested run, "" one parent (cache_hit event records different requested parent). Ignored refit = TRUE. fit_fun Function f(model, data, est) returns fit. Default: nlmixr2 fit strategy pk_est(). Mainly useful tests. quiet Suppress progress messages? proj pk_project object. title: Fit a model and register it in the ledger — pk_run
text: compiles specification nlmixr2 code, computes run key specification (generated code), data estimation settings, returns existing run combination already completed parent (caching, see cache; use refit = TRUE force new fit), registers run (parent, stage note) ledger, fits model, stores fit.rds, result.rds, spec.rds, model.txt, settings.rds diag.rds models/<run_id>/, updates ledger OFV, dOFV parent, AIC, condition number, covariance step status, shrinkage, number flags. run complete recorded status "failed" error message, error re-thrown. covers error fit, error results extracted stored, interrupt (message says run interrupted). run therefore never left status "running" unless R process killed. cache respects lineage. identical model fitted different parent different step development history, cache = "same_parent" (default) fitted new run. run re-run (pk_run("run003") without changes) returns run. cache = "" earlier run returned whatever parent; event log run records cache_hit requested parent, attempted derivation stays visible pk_audit().

title: Stepwise covariate modelling (SCM) — pk_scm
text: Forward step: remaining candidates added one time current model; candidate largest drop OFV included drop exceeds chi-square criterion 1 df forward_p (default 0.01, dOFV > 6.63). Backward step: included candidate removed one time; one smallest increase OFV removed increase criterion backward_p (default 0.001, dOFV > 10.83). Runs selected step marked rejected (dOFV reason) decide_trials = TRUE; runs selected path stay pending analyst records decision.

Declarative model specification — pk_spec
text: model described data, code: structure (number compartments, route, lag time), inter-individual variability (IIV), omega blocks, inter-occasion variability (IOV), residual error model, covariate relationships, initial estimates. pk_compile() turns specification nlmixr2 model function.

code: pk_spec(   ncmt = 2,   route = c("oral", "iv"),   lag = FALSE,   iiv = NULL,   blocks = list(),   iov = NULL,   error = c("prop", "add", "comb"),   covariates = NULL,   extra_thetas = list(),   inits = list(),   custom_fn = NULL )

title: Declarative model specification — pk_spec
text: ncmt Number compartments (1 2). route "oral" (first-order absorption) "iv". lag Include absorption lag time (oral )? iiv Parameters IIV. Default: clearance central volume. blocks List character vectors; defines omega block, e.g. list(c("cl", "v2")). iov NULL list param, occasion (column name) levels, see pk_add_iov(). error Residual error model: "prop", "add" "comb". covariates Covariate relationships (tibble, see pk_add_cov()). extra_thetas Named list additional fixed-effect parameters (name = initial value) written ini block. inits Named list initial estimates (natural scale): structural parameters, prop.sd, add.sd, om (named vector IIV variances) om_cov (named vector block covariances, e.g. c(cl.v2 = 0.01)). Missing entries get defaults. custom_fn Escape hatch: ready-made nlmixr2 model function. given, used arguments ignored (except bookkeeping), editing verbs pk_add_iiv() apply.
